name: PhenoApps
observation_method: Sequential connected-GitHub inventory and bounded default-history/source reads; selected fields transcribed, not a raw API export.
sampled_commit_scope: Latest default-history item returned at this repository read; not all branches or local state and not an atomic end-of-audit head.
movement: Default branch is apps-extract, not main. Recent sampled commits absorb NetWeave; collection-level capability and release completeness were not established.
role: Application collection with distinct product contracts
concerns: Shared repository does not make Localbase, fitness, focus and other apps one runtime or one release.
Use current apps-extract source; do not audit an assumed main branch.
Future planned donors are not automatically authorized migrations.

next_actions.title: Build the per-application atlas
next_actions.work: Inventory each app entrypoint, domain, manifest, data/secret ownership, packaging and consumer; distinguish recovered snapshots from integrated runnable apps.
next_actions.acceptance: Every material app has a disposition, active source, missing-obligation record and exact owner; unknown is not discarded.

next_actions.title: Complete one runnable app without blocking the collection
next_actions.work: Select the nearest accepted useful application and qualify install/onboarding/state/recovery. Keep unrelated applications independently buildable.
next_actions.acceptance: Real role-specific CVP and clean isolated build; no collection-wide completeness claim.

next_actions.title: Refine shared boundaries with PhenoShared
next_actions.work: Move only approved stable shared capabilities through contract-tested adapters; preserve each application semantics and private data.
next_actions.acceptance: Consumer acceptance and provenance retained; no speculative framework or global version lockstep.

ecosystem_contract: PhenoApps owns app-specific jobs; PhenoShared owns only accepted reusable capabilities. Donor movement requires a separate accepted record.
parent_acceptance: Each selected application becomes independently understandable, buildable and usable while collection custody remains intact.
scope_missing: actual chat receipts and read acknowledgement
